title: 7OS 0.8
description: a small real-mode OS: 7FS filesystem, INT 1Ch clock, shell, mode 13h demo

title: 7PLAYER
description: the day job, in 8086: a streaming video player with RC4 DRM (key ladder, license, per-frame keys), ABR and buffering
keys: space pause, left/right seek, D drm debug, N network glitch, M sound

title: 7INTRO
description: a 90s demoscene intro: starfield, fire, copper bars, tunnel, sine scroller and PC speaker music

title: 7MAZE
description: a Wolfenstein-style raycaster through a gallery of Ali's work: fixed-point DDA, textured walls, distance shading, posters with info cards
keys: arrows/WASD walk and turn, Q/E strafe, M minimap, F fps

title: 7GUI
description: a tiny windowed desktop in mode 13h: PS/2 mouse, draggable windows, z-order, taskbar clock, pixel-art icons
keys: double-click icons, drag title bars, Esc closes, Tab cycles, Enter opens

title: SNAKE · 512 bytes
description: classic snake in a single 512-byte boot sector: the screen is the board, the body is a ring buffer

title: INVADERS · 512 bytes
description: space invaders in a single 512-byte boot sector: the invaders exist only in video memory and march by block moves
keys: left/right move, space fires, any key restarts

title: PANIC · 512 bytes
description: an original 512-byte boot sector game: the mascot dodges falling bugs and SEGFAULTs that rain faster and thicker; one hit and she panics
keys: hold left/right to run, space restarts
